repo_path.description: Git 仓库在本地的路径（绝对路径），用于定位要读取提交记录的仓库，例如 '/home/user/myproject' 或 '/Users/alice/repo'
repo_path.title: Repo Path

max_count.description: 最多返回的提交记录数量，正整数，例如 10 表示最多返回最近 10 条提交
max_count.title: Max Count

start_timestamp.description: Start timestamp for filtering commits. Accepts: ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T14:30:25'), relative dates (e.g., '2 weeks ago', 'yesterday'), or absolute dates (e.g., '2024-01-15', 'Jan 15 2024')（可为空：不需要时传空字符串或 0）
start_timestamp.title: Start Timestamp

end_timestamp.description: End timestamp for filtering commits. Accepts: ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T14:30:25'), relative dates (e.g., '2 weeks ago', 'yesterday'), or absolute dates (e.g., '2024-01-15', 'Jan 15 2024')（可为空：不需要时传空字符串或 0）
end_timestamp.title: End Timestamp
